name: Mummified Undead
background:
The Mummified Undead command a massive army of undying skeletons and mummies. They are supported by great constructs made of bone and rock, animated by their Gods.

These undead creatures are the shambling corpses left behind when their once prosperous Kingdoms collapsed. When the Desert Gods were driven from the underworld by the Gods of Havoc, their followers were barred from the afterlife. Since then, their souls have been shackled to their lifeless bodies. Only their new Queen offers them the hope of final death.
backgroundFull:
The Mummified Undead were once a Human kingdom in the southern desert lands of Tyria. These people worshipped the Desert Gods, powerful beings which existed at the source of the great river which flowed between the world of the living and the dead. Protected from invasion by great swathes of desert, the Kingdom prospered for generations in the south. 

The Kingdom’s fortunes changed with the arrival of the Havoc Gods. The Havoc Gods sought out the Desert Gods and their Underworld, hoping to seal off death itself from Tyria. The Desert Gods tried to fight back, but were defeated. The Gatekeeper, who guarded the passage between the world of the living and dead, was slain, and the god’s blood poisoned the river passage between worlds. Since that moment, any soul that tried to pass on would be trapped in the poisoned river between worlds, existing in a state of constant agony. 

The remaining Desert Gods gave their priests Soul Gems, which could bind souls to their bodies. The Gems’ magic preserved the bones, allowing souls to linger even after their bodies had withered away to old age or injury. The Priests developed a form of mummification to allow people to preserve some part of their bodies. Those who could afford such treatments sought them out, while others slowly saw their flesh fall away until all that remained was bone. 

The Kingdom collapsed in the wake of the curse, as once vital farmlands lay barren and people fell into despair. The Mummified Undead were ruled over by a variety of lesser kings and petty tyrants who began to carve out kingdoms throughout the land. This led to a long era of civil war, as no one held the means to claim a final victory and reunite these lands into a single Kingdom. 

This changed with the arrival of a powerful sorceress from the north, claiming to be the heir of a mighty Empire. She approached the priests and kings of the land and promised that she alone had the power to discover a means to break their curse and bring them true death. Impressed with her power, her allies declared her the Tomb Queen, and soon reunified the realm under her rule, reigning over a variety of petty kingdoms and cultures which have emerged along the sacred river. 

Now, the Tomb Queen looks north to her former home. How will you embrace true death?

product.description: Once a proud and beautiful prince, Rammit saw his flesh fall from his bones as his people fell under a curse that left them as the Mummified Undead. This curse was a fate worse than death for the vain duellist, who could not find any consolation for this pain in his now eternal life. Rammit went into self-imposed exile with a handful of Royal Guards, seeking to break the curse’s hold upon him by any means necessary.

specialRules.name: No Retreat Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get No Retreat.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Royal Legion
specialRules.description: This model gets +6" range when using Hold actions and shooting, and moves +2" when using Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Indirect when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Indirect when shooting.

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Fortified.

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Spell Resistance.

specialRules.name: Scout Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Scout.

specialRules.name: Bane in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Bane in melee.

specialRules.name: Bane in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Bane in melee.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Royal Legion
specialRules.description: If this model has Royal Legion, it gets +12" range when using Hold actions and shooting, and moves +4" when using Charge actions from Royal Legion (instead of only +6" and +2").

specialRules.name: Entrenched
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12” away get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Cumbersome
specialRules.description: May only use Hold or Advance actions, but can’t shoot when moving.

specialRules.name: Piercing Spotter
specialRules.description: Once per activation, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(X) on their weapons, where X is the number of removed tokens.

specialRules.name: Surprise Attack
specialRules.description: This model counts as having Ambush, and may be deployed up to 1" away from enemy units (instead of over 9" away). Once deployed, roll X dice. For each 2+ one enemy unit within 3” takes 2 hits with AP(1).

specialRules.name: Pierce
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, this weapon gets AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Difficult Terrain Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Difficult terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Royal Legion Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Enhanced Royal Legion.

specialRules.name: Extra Reach
specialRules.description: This model gets +6" range when using Hold actions and shooting, and moves +2" when using Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Extra Reach
specialRules.description: If this model has Extra Reach, it gets +12" range when using Hold actions and shooting, and moves +4" when using Charge actions from Extra Reach (instead of only +6" and +2").

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Heroes with up to Tough(6) may deploy as part of one multi-model unit without another Hero, but must use the unit’s Defense until all other models have been killed. The Hero’s unit, and units within 6” of friendly Heroes with Tough(9) or higher, may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Indirect
specialRules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with Tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Scout
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Infiltrate
specialRules.description: This model counts as having Ambush, and may be deployed fully within 12" of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
